notes: Ctrl+F searches the chat log, in a floating find bar in the top-right corner — type to highlight every match, Enter to step through them, Esc to close
It starts on the newest match rather than the oldest, and the results stay live as the conversation carries on
Pressing Ctrl+F again with a search already in the box lets you type straight over it
Tab to swap your languages works again — it had been dead for as long as the top bar has existed
